purpose: Diversity harvest prompts for corpus building (F0.5). Single-room interiors only, matched to the V11 pipeline's scope: one room, floor-mounted and ceiling-mounted objects, a door, optional windows. Harvest sessions are DIAGNOSTIC evidence only - never qualification evidence. The canonical diner prompt remains the only qualification prompt.
author: Claude (Cowork) - reviewed by John
